configurePresets.name: bench-all-sota
configurePresets.displayName: benchmarks + ALL gated SOTA rivals (DEV-ONLY, not a product build)
configurePresets.description: DEV/BENCH-ONLY one-shot: flips every -DHYLE_BENCH_* gate ON so each bench races its real SOTA rival (not just std). These HYLE_BENCH_* gates are a SEPARATE category from the product build params (HYLE_STATIC/SANITIZER/WERROR/ISA tier) -- they ONLY add comparison rows to the benchmarks and NEVER affect the shipped library. The clone-based rivals (absl/tbb/marl/moodycamel/rigtorp/boost) must be present as repo siblings first: run scripts/setup-bench-libs.sh (boost::intrusive needs the boost submodule checked out). Highway/xsimd/simdutf are VENDORED in third_party (no clone needed) -- their gates just toggle the comparison rows. Vectorized exp/log/tanh + utf8 are already unconditional in the product build (no flag).
